name: useDataGridState
purpose: Controlled or uncontrolled coordinator for complete DataGridState outside UniversalDataGrid.

guidance.useWhen: Use when application code needs to own and pass complete grid view state through documented package-root APIs.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for row data, fetching, auth, permissions, business workflows, or internal resize/reorder coordination.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Experimental public API. Use only from the package root and pass complete next state back in controlled mode. Do not import internal grid hooks.

accessibility: The hook is non-visual; consumers must preserve accessible grid controls when applying state.
knownLimitations: Avoid for row data, fetching, auth, permissions, business workflows, or internal resize/reorder coordination.
